Class ServerController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.controller.ServerController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandReceiver, ClientConnectionUser
public class ServerController extends Object implements ClientConnectionUser, CommandReceiver
Global server-side controller. Serves as the central coordinator for network access. Manages client states, initializes new match instances, and routes gameplay updates securely to their respective localized GameController instances.
